llm.summary: The skill is a coherent AI launch-monitoring tool, but its optional screenshot mode opens discovered URLs in unsandboxed Chromium and should be reviewed before use.

dimensions.detail: The screenshot path collects URLs from RSS and search results, accepts any string starting with http, and launches headless Chromium with --no-sandbox, which is broader and less isolated than necessary for public launch monitoring.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hooks, package installation, credential setup, or automatic execution were found; use is through an explicit shell script command.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses network collection, local output, and optional screenshots, but trigger phrases such as AI news digest are broad enough that users may not expect a full shell-based collection workflow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill writes reports, raw items, and screenshots under a timestamped local output directory and includes a user-directed cron example, but no hidden persistence or privilege escalation was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: RSS polling, DuckDuckGo search, local report generation, and optional screenshots match the stated AI product launch monitoring purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a shell script fetching public web content and writing local reports. Avoid screenshot mode or scheduled screenshot runs unless you trust the feed/query sources, and prefer adding URL validation, private-network blocking, and browser isolation first.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Shell execution, outbound fetching, and local file writes are expected for this monitoring pipeline and are described, though permission boundaries could be clearer.
[SQP-1] expected: The triggers are related to AI launch monitoring, but some are broad and could select the skill for a general digest request.
[SQP-2] expected: Web search, screenshots, and output location are documented; retention and network-access warnings could be more explicit.
[OH1] unexpected: Optional screenshot capture is purpose-aligned, but passing unvalidated discovered URLs to unsandboxed Chromium is an avoidable implementation risk.
